definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese cooking and dishes, characterized by emphasis on seasonal ingredients, presentation, and balanced nutrition.

examples.japanese: {和食|わしょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。

examples.english: Japanese food is good for the body.

examples.japanese: {和食|わしょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ユネスコ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無形文化遺産|むけいぶんかいさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese cuisine is registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

notes:
{和食|わしょく} is composed of {和|わ} (Japanese) + {食|しょく} (food). It refers to traditional Japanese cuisine as a whole, emphasizing seasonal ingredients, beautiful presentation, and nutritional balance.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {和食|わしょく}⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧: Japanese restaurant
- {和食|わしょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: Japanese food restaurant
- {和食|わしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make Japanese food
- {和食|わしょく}⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧: centered on Japanese food

CONTRAST WITH OTHER CUISINE TYPES:
- {和食|わしょく}: Japanese food
- ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧: Western-style food (Japanese-adapted Western dishes)
- ⟦{中華|ちゅうか}→中華：11322_chuuka⟧: Chinese food
- ⟦{韓国料理|かんこくりょうり}→韓国料理：25590_kankokuryouri⟧: Korean food

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和食|わしょく}: Japanese cuisine (everyday term, contrasts with foreign food)
- ⟦{日本料理|にほんりょうり}→日本料理：19425_nihonryouri⟧: Japanese cooking (slightly more formal/refined)

{和食|わしょく} was registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2013.
